snippet.title: Legion Draft - Official Announcement Trailer (Fantasy Auto-Battler inspired by HoMM)
snippet.description:
Legion Draft is an async PvP fantasy auto-battler where every card is a growing troop stack.

Draft troops, build your economy, recruit soldiers, and deploy your army across multiple lanes to outplay other players. Each race has its own mechanics and synergies, so every run gives you new ways to build your legion.

This is the official Announcement Trailer for Legion Draft.
